package.name: livox_msgs
package.description: Livox custom message definitions (CustomMsg, CustomPoint). Byte-compatible with livox_ros_driver2 so downstream Livox-optimised SLAM (FAST-LIO2, Point-LIO, LIO-SAM Livox) can subscribe without code changes. Vendored here so the sim doesn't require the full livox_ros_driver2 install.
